name: ModelVariant781_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant781_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two orbs leave each of two model parts ringed by spinning sparks and ray fans while the camera pans and the light dims, each landing orb opening into a halo ring, fading glows and falling debris); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x34-byte command row indexed by the request and seeds the orbs, sparks, rays, halos and debris, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 when each of the first three orbs lands, 1 when the last lands, 2 once the last glow has faded in phase 2 and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-798 and 895 images build the same source directly at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
